title: Events improvements: Buy Ticket with attendance sheet, photo gallery, crowd/capacity + FOMO meter, event theme and announcement bar
notes: Events directory + detail now show crowd/capacity progress, HOT/WARM/COLD FOMO meter, themed accents, and provider announcement bar
Buy Ticket modal lets members reserve spots (respects capacity, recorded to the event attendance sheet) with check-in management for providers
Provider event form grows capacity, theme, announcement and multi-photo gallery fields; admin event view shows capacity/going/theme/announcement
Every page carries a 2k2-version meta stamp so the app detects stale shells and force-reloads onto the current build
Bumped tokens (script.js?v=61, style.css?v=47, admin.js?v=40), meta 2.3.20 on all 9 shells, version.json 2.3.20, SW epoch 2k2-v22
